fi

arguments.command:
termy_say -s "Please enter the directory name to delete" &&
printf "\r\n📁 Enter the directory name to delete: " &&
read -r dname &&
if [ -d "$dname" ]; then
 rm -rf "$dname" &&
 printf "\nDirectory \033[1m%s\033[22m has been recursively deleted.\n" "$dname" &&
 termy_say -s "Directory deleted successfully";
else
 printf "\n⛔ Directory does not exist.\n" &&
 termy_say -s "Directory not found";
fi
arguments.explanation: Deletes a directory after prompting for the folder name and verifying its existence.

input: compress a directory into an archive
create an archive from a directory
create zip or tar from a directory

arguments.command:
termy_question "Please enter the directory to compress" source_dir &&
if [ -d "$source_dir" ]; then
 termy_question "Please choose an archive format:

1) TAR.GZ - Linux standard
2) ZIP - Cross platform

Choose format 1-2" arch_choice
 case "$arch_choice" in
  1)
   tar -czf "$source_dir.tar.gz" "$source_dir" &&
   printf "\nArchive \033[1m%s.tar.gz\033[22m created.\n" "$source_dir" &&
   termy_say -s "Archive created successfully"
  ;;
  2)
   zip -r "$source_dir.zip" "$source_dir" &&
   printf "\nArchive \033[1m%s.zip\033[22m created.\n" "$source_dir" &&
   termy_say -s "Archive created successfully"
  ;;
  *)
   printf "\n⛔ Invalid choice.\n" &&
   termy_say -s "Invalid selection"
  ;;
 esac;
else
 printf "\n⛔ Directory does not exist.\n" &&
 termy_say -s "Directory not found";
fi
arguments.explanation: Compresses a directory into either a TAR.GZ or ZIP archive based on user choice.

arguments.command:
termy_say -s "Analyzing folder sizes" &&
printf "\r\n" &&
du -sh -- */ 2>/dev/null |
sort -rh |
head -15 &&
printf ""
arguments.explanation: Calculates the disk usage of all top-level subdirectories, sorts them from largest to smallest, and displays the top 15.
